name: Arcade
pitch: A high-energy war-story talk framed as a game you can win, built to stay legible on a washed-out projector.

illustration.medium: flat vector, synthwave arcade-cabinet illustration on deep purple
illustration.line: 2 to 3px neon-glow strokes, crisp with a slight outer glow
illustration.shapes: sunset arcs, grid horizons, simple geometric mountains or shapes, retro-futurist composition
illustration.texture: faint scanline or grid-horizon perspective lines
illustration.palette_use: deep indigo/purple background dominant, hot pink accent used for the glowing focal element, sparing cyan for secondary glow
illustration.avoid: photorealism, soft pastel color, hand-drawn wobble, flat daylight lighting
